name: risk-assessment
description: Assess the risk level of a proposed action based on its potential impact and context

options.description: Minimal impact, easily reversible, affects non-critical systems or data
Moderate impact, requires some review, affects operational but not critical systems
Significant impact, requires approval, affects production or user-facing systems
Severe impact, irreversible or hard to roll back, affects core infrastructure or all users

evaluation_factors: Scope of affected systems and users
Potential for data loss or corruption
Time to detect and remediate if something goes wrong

metadata.purpose: Bounded risk assessment via JEV semantic matching
